gen-flavors-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mon: Flavors is built like bent rod, one gauge all the way round, with a towering lowercase that looks pressed out in chunky pencil. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono sits beneath it as a plain sans with stretched-open spacing and counters that breathe.
gen-flavors-gf-biryani: Flavors swings in with whimsical, commanding energy, its diagonals as hefty as its stems. Biryani follows as a plain sans with a wide-eyed e and no thick-to-thin shifts, so every small counter stays clear.
gen-flavors-gf-blinker: Flavors is all stubby, pencil-thick swagger up top. Blinker does the quieter job below, a plain sans whose lines hold their thickness and whose open apertures keep the text easy to take in.
gen-flavors-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads modern and businesslike, with a high-set x-height and a generous opening in its c. Flavors, bent like tubing, earns its place when it is big and brief.
gen-flavors-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads contemporary, with capitals and lowercase nearly the same height. Over a longer stretch that closeness gives text a tidy, uniform texture, and each curve ends in a clear opening while Flavors shouts above.
gen-flavors-gf-chivo: Flavors brings whimsy and command, its n built with arch and stem matching and its x-height towering. Chivo takes over below as a sans with lowercase packed up toward the caps and daylight showing through every curve.
gen-flavors-gf-chocolate-classical-sans: Stencil-flat and cheerfully bossy, Flavors draws every line at the same weight with a tall, pencil-stroke lowercase. And Chocolate Classical Sans answers with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut.
gen-flavors-gf-comme: Flavors is rope-thin outline, whimsical and a bit domineering, with no thick or thin parts anywhere. And Comme carries the reading, a modern plain sans with smooth, unclogged curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-flavors-gf-cossette-texte: Flavors draws its diagonals as hefty as its stems, under a lowercase that towers like a carpenter's pencil. Cossette Texte is the clean counterweight, with a wide-eyed e and n arches as thick as their stems.
gen-flavors-gf-duru-sans: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors is built from rounded rod in a single weight. And Duru Sans sits beside it as a modern, clean plain sans, its small letters wide open and its bodies dominating the line.
